Dear you who love Korean food
Various Korean food start with "Jang(Korean style paste)" and "Jeot(Korean style salted seafood)".
Jang is mostly made by fermenting soybean (and etc) in "Jangdok(Korean style big jar)".
Jeot is made by salted seafood (sometimes with hot pepper powder) in Jangdok.
Also, Sikhae refers to seafood fermented with rice and hot pepper powder!
I hope this mod will help you learn about Jangdok, Jang, Jeot and Sikhae.

p.s "Jangdokdae" = Jangdok + Dae(Place). Jangdokdae means a place where Jangdok is placed.

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]< Install the mode >[/size][/font]
Decompressed the downloaded zip file in the Stardew Valley mods folder.
Then you'll have "[Ksoul] Jangdok" folder.
